Metadata.title: omero
Metadata.description: Self-hosted social media publisher: write, schedule and publish to X and LinkedIn from your own server.

StatusHint.partially_published: Live on some networks; others failed.
StatusHint.failed: Could not be published after retries.
StatusHint.missed: The server was down at that time.

header.title: Design system
header.subtitle: omero's color, type and components, in light and dark.

hero.title: Write once and publish to X and LinkedIn from your own server.
hero.body: Every post has a version per network, a time slot and a status you can read at a glance. These are the pieces the calendar and the composer are built from.

samplePost.author: Omero Demo
samplePost.body: I moved the scheduler to queues with retries: three attempts with backoff and no cron at all. Here is how, in a thread.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Roasted coffee for the brand, vivid colors for action.

statuses.title: Post statuses
statuses.description: Each network gets its own delivery; the post status is derived from them.
statuses.calendarPreview: How they look on the calendar

networks.title: Networks
networks.description: X and LinkedIn in this stage. Instagram and Facebook come later.

tabs.baseBody: The base text is used on every network that has no version of its own.
tabs.xBody: On X you can split the text into a thread; each part stays within the character limit.
tabs.linkedinBody: On LinkedIn the post is a single item and allows longer text.

dialog.title: Delete this scheduled post?
dialog.description: It will be removed from the queue and the calendar. This cannot be undone.

popover.title: Next free slot
popover.body: Tomorrow at 09:00, based on your queue times.

tooltip.content: On the X API, posts with links cost more.

toast.title: Post scheduled
toast.description: It will be published today at 09:00.

type.title: Type and shape
type.description: Bricolage Grotesque for headings and numbers; Figtree for the interface.
type.sampleBody: Three posts scheduled this week. The next one goes out early tomorrow on X and LinkedIn.

strength.empty: At least 12 characters. A long phrase beats a strange word.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to write, schedule and publish.

user.logoutFailed: Could not sign out. Try again.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Connect the accounts you publish to. We use each network's official access, and you can revoke it whenever you want.

empty.title: Connect your first network
empty.body: You don't have any connected account yet. Connect X or LinkedIn and start writing and scheduling your posts from one place.

card.notConnectedBody: Connect your {network} account to write, schedule and publish from omero.
card.disconnectedBody: You disconnected this account. Connect it again to publish to it.
card.needsReconnectBody: This account needs to be authorized again. Until then we can't publish to it.

expiry.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

notConfigured.title: {network} isn't configured
notConfigured.body: Set these environment variables on the server and restart the API:

longPosts.label: Long posts (X Premium)
longPosts.description: Lets each X post go past 280 characters. Turn it on only if your account has X Premium.
longPosts.saveError: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {handle}?
disconnectDialog.body: We'll delete the access tokens and won't be able to publish to this account anymore.
disconnectDialog.scheduledNote: Posts scheduled for this channel will be flagged for you to review and won't be published. Your history is kept.
disconnectDialog.error: Couldn't disconnect the channel. Try again.

errors.access_denied: You canceled the authorization, so we didn't connect the account. You can try again whenever you want.
errors.provider_error: The network returned an error while authorizing. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.state_invalid: The connection request expired or was already used. Start the connection again.
errors.state_mismatch: The connection request doesn't belong to this session. Start the connection again.
errors.missing_code: The network didn't send us the authorization code. Try again.
errors.exchange_failed: We couldn't complete the authorization with the network. Check the app credentials and try again.
errors.profile_failed: The account was authorized, but we couldn't read its profile. Try again.
errors.not_configured: That network has no credentials configured on the server.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while connecting the account. Try again.

queue.title: Publishing queue
queue.description: Set the weekly times used by “Add to queue”: each post takes the first free slot from now on.
queue.presetHint: Replaces every time in the week.
queue.slotCount: {count, plural, =0 {No times} one {# time} other {# times}}
queue.duplicate: There is already a slot at {time} that day.

empty.title: You don't have any slots yet
empty.body: Without slots, “Add to queue” has nowhere to put your posts. Start with the preset and tweak it to your liking.

queue.saveError: Couldn't save the queue. Try again.

preview.label: Next free slot
preview.none: There are no free slots in the next 30 days.
preview.noSlots: Add times to see the next free slot.
preview.error: Couldn't work out the next slot.

general.title: General
general.description: The time zone used to show and schedule your posts, and how much leeway late posts get.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: The calendar, the queue and the date picker use this zone. Posts are stored in UTC, so changing it doesn't move anything already scheduled.
timezone.search: Search a zone (for example, Buenos Aires)

grace.label: Leeway for late posts
grace.help: If the server was down and a post ran late, we publish it when it comes back as long as less time than this has passed. If more has passed, it's marked as “missed” and we notify you. Between 1 and 48 hours.
grace.invalid: Enter a whole number of hours between 1 and 48.

general.saveError: Couldn't save the settings. Try again.

calendar.title: The calendar is on its way
calendar.body: You will see your posts by week and month here. Meanwhile, you can start writing one.

settings.title: Settings are on their way
